title: Mega Millions jackpot jumps to $629M for Friday, Nov. 20 drawing
text:

 Fernando Cervantes Jr. USA TODAY Updated Nov. 20, 2026, 11:14 p.m. ET Hear this story The Mega Millions jackpot rose to $629 million ahead of the Friday, Nov. 20 drawing with a cash value of $258.8 million.
 If someone were lucky enough to win the jackpot on Friday, they’ll have two options : take home a one-time, lump-sum cash payment or receive an immediate payment followed by annual checks, each 5% larger than the previous year.
 The last time someone won the Mega Millions was on July 28 when a Florida player took home a staggering $800 million jackpot with a cash value of $344.2 million. Florida lottery officials said the winning ticket was sold at a Wawa in Bradenton, Florida.
 Here is what you need to know about Friday’s Mega Millions drawing, including the winning numbers.
 What are the winning Mega Millions numbers for 11/20/2026?
 The winning numbers for Friday’s Mega Millions lottery are 32, 35, 48, 58 and 61. The Mega Ball is 21 .
 Holiday shopping: Find the best deals and gifts across tech, home, outdoors and more When is the next Mega Millions drawing?
 The next Mega Millions drawing is scheduled for Tuesday, November 24, at 11 p.m. ET.
 How to play the Mega Millions
 Mega Millions tickets are sold at convenience stores, gas stations, grocery stores and other lottery retailers. Some states also allow online purchases.
 Players choose five white-ball numbers from 1 to 70 and one gold Mega Ball number from 1 to 24. Don't want to pick your own? Ask for a Quick Pick, and the numbers will auto-generate for you.
 Mega Millions tickets now include a built-in multiplier that boosts non-jackpot prizes by two, three, four, five or 10 times. Previously, players had to pay extra to add the Megaplier option.
